title: The 10 Best Solar Pool Covers
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for solar pool covers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at solar pool covers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Blue Wave NS110 18-Ft Round Solar Blanket for Above-Ground Pools, 8-Mil
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-mil polyethylene bubble construction, 18-ft round sizing for above-ground pools, Raises water temperature up to 10-15 degrees F in full sun.
strengths: Highest review count (3,800+) of any solar cover in this roundup, the most-option for round above-ground pools
Lowest price entry point into meaningful heat gain and evaporation control
8-mil thickness is light enough for one person to handle removal and refitting without a reel
Trimmable edges let it be sized down to match a pool slightly smaller than 18 feet
limitations: 3 to 5 year lifespan is the shortest of the mil-thickness tiers, needs replacing sooner than a 12-mil cover
Thinner material is more prone to puncture and UV degradation over a season of full sun exposure
Round-only sizing, not usable on a rectangular or oval pool
features: Raises water temperature up to 10-15 degrees F in full sun
Trimmable at bubble seams for a custom fit

products.name: Blue Wave NS480 15-Ft Round Solar Blanket for Above-Ground Pools, 12-Mil Clear
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-mil clear polyethylene bubble construction, 15-ft round sizing for above-ground pools, Clear tint for maximum direct-sunlight transmission.
strengths: Clear tint transmits slightly more direct sunlight than a blue cover of the same thickness, a marginal heating edge in full sun
12-mil thickness lasts noticeably longer (5-7 years) than the 8-mil budget round option
Compact 15-ft sizing suits smaller above-ground pools without needing to trim excess material
limitations: Clear material offers less algae-limiting shade than a blue cover, since it passes more light through to the water
Heavier than the 8-mil round option, slightly more effort to remove and store
Clear covers show dirt and cloudiness more visibly than tinted blue covers over time
features: Clear tint for maximum direct-sunlight transmission

products.name: Blue Wave NS420 16x32 Ft Rectangle Solar Pool Cover 12-Mil Blue
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-mil blue polyethylene bubble construction, 16x32 ft rectangle sizing, 5-year seam warranty.
strengths: 16x32 sizing matches the most common rectangular above-ground and inground pool footprint
5-year seam warranty backs the bubble-to-bubble bonding, the point most solar covers fail first
12-mil thickness balances durability and handling weight better than 8-mil for a cover left on most of the season
Blue tint helps limit algae growth while still delivering the standard bubble-lens heat gain
limitations: Heavier than an 8-mil cover of the same footprint, harder for one person to remove without a reel
Costs more upfront than the budget 8-mil rectangle option in this roundup
Rectangle-only sizing, requires trimming or a different shape for an oval or round pool
features: Raises water temperature up to 10-15 degrees F in full sun

strengths: 24x40 sizing covers large inground rectangles without needing to piece together multiple smaller covers

limitations: Lower review count (780) than the standard-size rectangle covers, reflecting the smaller buyer pool for large inground sizing
